scope: All primary joint-callable positions; direct independent CIGAR-block/count implementation.
filters: MAPQ>=30,BQ>=25,proper flag2,exclude0xF0C,qualified ACGT observations collapsed per QNAME; conflicting ACGT names excluded. Query sequence in BAM alignment orientation; no extra reverse complement.
sensitivity: Clean requires no S anywhere in read CIGAR and >=5 query bases between locus and each aligned query end. MAPQ60 and NH==1-if-present are separate sensitivity masks. None certifies uniqueness.
excluded_from_exact_comparison: nonACGT symbolic deletion/refskip accounting is not reconstructed; exact comparison covers ACGT alleles, conflicts and REF/ALT read counts only.
